folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B418: partial original-plan review, lines1–615
folds.body:
This pass actually reads lines1–615, through CL128 and the start of section15.2. Sections after that point and later reconciliation folds remain outside this partial pass; do not mark the plan fully reviewed. The original prefix is bound by the reviewed-prefix hash in B418, so later continuation can verify that exact portion before combining coverage.

**Authority and history:** S1–S4 preserve merge/crosswalk, worksheets, paragraph-qualified records and actual engine readers as different stages. Opening F2/F6/F7/F8 describe an October28 snapshot; later L1 and integration receipts already read in B413–B417 supersede selected missing-merge/unwired/prepared labels. Reopening every merge is not required. The early beside-seat/D1/D2 and narrow week are historical choices; current PROJECT prioritizes Klein’s developer route, Harry Potter alongside and later low-spoiler ordinary starts. The additive branch/save decision stays useful history without becoming a new current start default. SUI’s proposed label and waiting-for-acceptance text are superseded by the present owning UI rules; no new adoption occurs here.

**Useful causal distinctions:** source silence stays unknown, not false/free; source order is not a global clock across MoL restarts. A place/scene/registry label does not create a person, item, date, inventory or implemented role. Same-named item types differ from actual held instances. A reported whereabouts, thought, plan or claimed fact cannot move a body or assert world truth. Physical fatigue/recovery and source-qualified work need their actual consumers. Presence counts can guide delivery without proving complete lives or a source-wide tier law.

**CL6–CL50:** off-screen outcome, witnessed nonparticipation and player-caused divergence are different routes. A dependency count is a planning clue; real agents need their own knowledge, motives and means before causing pushback. Temporal protection requires the world’s actual mechanism/time model. The older always-pay-enough/no-wall promise is not universal: a source-grounded absolute or self-consistent history can genuinely constrain an attempted change under its stated means, while the broader project still permits reasoned exceptions. A future actor, prophecy or genuine protection must not be erased by a no-halo implementation slogan. Unknown time law remains unknown; Ordinary is a provisional authoring fallback, not proof about the entire book. Observation-safe quotes may expose supported signs without revealing sealed truth or pretending an unknown reason is known. Keyed weight/collision formulas are proposals, not verified current fate machinery.

**CL29–CL71:** book-row rates and later co-presence are not causal or representative NPC behavior by themselves. Preserve provenance, held-out testing and inferred labels; explicit person/world facts outrank statistical fills. Reaction, perceived cause, remembered knowledge, relationship state, intention and later performed act remain distinct. Repetition damping, group attitude and reputation aggregation are optional local designs: they do not impose universal diminishing returns, forced gossip or a ban on an institution’s real reputation/authority mechanism. Genuine repeated useful gains and quiet settled lives remain possible. The later L7 result is classifier placement, not held-out accuracy; L2c’s co-presence pairs do not establish actual directed response.

**CL72–CL128:** preserve changed data probes, L1 identity guard, corrected selection regex, role-hour gaps and labelled fills, but read old running/waiting/landed/commit/CLI/sandbox/credit-lapse labels as dated receipts. CL98 is corrected by CL103 within the plan; neither is a fresh tool installation or allowance check. Old model recommendations, automatic numerical stops, two-writer ceilings and commit instructions are not present dispatch or authorization. Current AD51 allows an appropriate useful first shared seam; another book validates/revises it. This task launches no reader, worker, runtime check or source acquisition and changes no accepted direction.
